 Through: Mr. Pradeel Gahlot, App for
 Si Arti Singh, Ps Sector 23
 Coram:

HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANISH DAYAL  ORDER % 21.02.2023 1. Exemption allowed subject to all just exceptions.
2. Application stands disposed of.

1. This petition has been filed seeking anticipatory bail for the petitioner in FIR No.4/2023 under sections 498A/406/376/328/34 IPC PS Dwarka Sector 23 on the ground that he has been falsely implicated in the present matter on account of a prior dispute between the family members.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner contends that the complainant is sister-in-law of petitioner and on an earlier occasion, an FIR had been lodged by his sister's daughter against the complainant alleging offences involving Immoral Trafficking Act.

Ld. APP for the State accepts notice and has informed that the petitioner is not cooperating in the investigation and the State intends to retrieve data from his mobile phone on which he has allegedly recorded images of the complainant.
4. The State shall file a status report before the next date of hearing.
5. Learned counsel for the petitioner states that the petitioner is ready and willing to join the investigation and shall appear before the IO, as and when directed.
6. Petitioner shall accordingly appear before the IO on 23rd February, 2023 at PS Dwarka Sector 23 at 4:00 P.M. and will surrender his mobile phone, for the purpose as mentioned above.
